title: Up-Down Counter (CTUD)
ab_note: Studio 5000 has CTUD (up/down) with .ACC; or do the manual edges above with BOOL memory tags.
siemens_note: SCL uses the IEC CTUD FB: CU (count up), CD (count down), with CV giving the current value; both inputs are edge-triggered internally.
task:
A buffer counts items IN and OUT. Given In_Sensor and Out_Sensor (BOOL) with
memory bits In_Prev, Out_Prev, and output Count : DINT:
  - +1 on the rising edge of In_Sensor
  - -1 on the rising edge of Out_Sensor
Update both memory bits at the end.
starter:
(* Lesson 10 -- Up-Down Counter (CTUD) *)

VAR
    In_Sensor  : BOOL;  (* N.O. entry photo-eye -> XIC (as-is) *)
    Out_Sensor : BOOL;  (* N.O. exit photo-eye  -> XIC (as-is) *)
    In_Prev    : BOOL;  (* entry edge memory                   *)
    Out_Prev   : BOOL;  (* exit edge memory                    *)
    Count      : DINT;  (* output: items currently in buffer   *)
END_VAR

(* ----- YOUR LOGIC : write your answer between these two lines ----- *)
    (* TODO: +1 on each entry rising edge, -1 on each exit rising edge; then update both memory bits. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

checks.message: Counts up on the In edge
Counts down on the Out edge
Executed: +1 per In edge, -1 per Out edge
checks.hint: One count per edge; holding an input high must not keep counting.
